open_claims.status: Lean-checked; both developments independently replayed (Toledo, kernel + nanoda), machine-model translation informal; review group (Impagliazzo, Paturi, Williams) running a discussion blog, not endorsing; simpler proofs by Kintali and O'Donnell; Fortnow: safe to assume (opinion); as of 2026-11-09 blog collecting Lean replications (Zane) and consequences (Paturi, 1 Nov), still no verdict
open_claims.watch: review group statement or virtual meeting, errors found, conference announcement

open_claims.claim: Local smoothing, Kakeya and Stein restriction in all dimensions (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Lean proof per OpenAI; no outside expert verdict found as of 2026-11-09
open_claims.watch: harmonic analysts' comments (Guth, Wang, Zahl, Tao), whether formal statement matches the conjecture

open_claims.claim: Existence of QCD and pure Yang-Mills in 4D (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Committee (Gross chair, Douglas, Jaffe, Klebanov, Nekrasov) says it 'appears to be an important step'; plans to validate Lean definitions, then release Lean proof, then assessment with 1,147-page proofs; mass gap and confinement open; still unreleased as of 2026-11-09; AGMAI (26 Oct) recommended immediate release

open_claims.claim: Quasi-Riemann hypothesis: zeta zeros in strip 1/8-7/8 (Lean) and 1/12-11/12 (informal) (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Quanta: experts largely agree 11/12 version correct; Radziwill can sketch it; Sarnak withholds 'theorem' until fully checked; private 7-13 page write-ups circulating
open_claims.watch: public human write-ups, any check of the 7/8 manuscript

open_claims.claim: Other October 6 release claims, incl. omega <= 9/4
open_claims.status: unverified individually, except Landau-Siegel (now separate entry)

open_claims.claim: Deterministic factoring in time N^o(1) (Rudich, Rousseau, Claude)
open_claims.status: Lean-checked 13-line statement; no human-readable proof yet; Glazer (via AI audit) says Lean matches its statement, English write-up has errors
open_claims.watch: human write-up, number theorists' review, extensions (e.g. deterministic discrete log)

open_claims.claim: Complete Lean formalization of CFSG (Axiom), with Walter UGT gap and repair
open_claims.status: kernel-checked per Axiom; no outside rebuild yet; formal-statement fidelity not yet human-reviewed; Lyons and Solomon advised on repair
open_claims.watch: independent rebuild, review of definitions, group theorists' assessment of errata

open_claims.claim: AI will weaken lattice crypto within two years (Buterin)
open_claims.status: prediction; no attack on ML-KEM/ML-DSA/unstructured LWE known; Bashiri's provable dual attack (human) explicitly does not threaten them
open_claims.watch: any AI result on standardized lattice schemes

open_claims.claim: No Landau-Siegel zeros: (1-beta) log q >= c (OpenAI, Oct 6 release)
open_claims.status: Lean-checked (statement fidelity not audited); independently reworked and simplified by Green, Kerr, Banks (explicit constants), Barreto (3 pages); Granville: 'It's all moot now'; no peer review yet
open_claims.watch: peer-reviewed version, audit of Lean statement

open_claims.claim: Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture: influence >= c Var^{5/2}/d^6 (PSI, non-public Anthropic model)
open_claims.status: Lean-checked (standard axioms, lean4lean second check); Aaronson believes it correct (blog, 8 Nov); PSI says Stanford group (Blanc, Docter, Strassle, Tan) reviewed it, not confirmed by them directly
open_claims.watch: Stanford exposition, audit of PrintedConjecture statement, peer review

open_claims.claim: DeepMind: ~1,600x cheaper affine-root RSA-1024 forgery (theoretical), ~30x cheaper batch factoring per key
open_claims.status: company claim in unreviewed working papers; only measured gain 3.5x on rerun of ePrint 2026/2131 computation; no Fan Factories implementation
open_claims.watch: papers on ePrint/peer review, implementation, cryptographers' assessment

open_claims.claim: No bound helium dianion (Shelley-Tartakovsky, with Claude)
open_claims.status: interval-arithmetic certificate on Zenodo; not rerun by outsiders; no Lean
open_claims.watch: independent rerun of certificate, extensions (He-, lithium)

open_claims.claim: Mezard-Parisi formula for random K-SAT / diluted even p-spin (Panchenko via ChatGPT Astra; separate OpenAI proof)
open_claims.status: preprint, human-checked by author; no outside review found
open_claims.watch: specialist reaction, comparison with OpenAI's proof
